title: Outcome loop: the agent applies a rule and the field confirms it
description: Demo path for the passive outcome loop: the ops agent applies the old-unit interface-bounce rule to TRN-117 and the technician's follow-up decides its outcome, with nobody asked to confirm anything.
subject: TRN-117 no traffic after SFP swap (agent follow-up)

incident.summary: No traffic on TRN-117 after an SFP swap

messages.text: Swapped the SFP on TRN-117 an hour ago. Link is UP, power looks normal, but counters sit at zero.
NOC here, same from our side, nothing passing through.
Ok, did the interface bounce just now. Traffic is back after the interface bounce!
Yep, counters are moving on our side too.
